title: fix(mcp): run_action and resume_run withhold a PERMISSION_DENIED's details, as the data tools do (#23529)
body:
Fixes #23529
Clause-②: no

`run_action` and `resume_run` now withhold a `PERMISSION_DENIED` refusal's `details`, as the data tools, the record resource, the runtime dispatcher and the REST actions door already do (the ruling on #7450). Every other coded refusal on the two tools keeps its `details`, so #15942's confirmation contract is unchanged.

Dispatched by the PM loop, `domain:spec` seat 4, building round after triage's regrade (comment 6177046363), claim 6177192097, session `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm`.

## What changed

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, `errorResultFromThrown` only (plus the one import it reads). A thrown refusal whose declared code is the standard catalogue's `PERMISSION_DENIED` now renders through `errorResultWithCode`, the function the data tools already render through, so its `details` are withheld. The code is spelled from `StandardErrorCode` (`@objectstack/spec/api`, already a dependency), not by hand. Every other coded refusal keeps its `details`. The `run_action` and `resume_run` catches are unchanged: both already call `errorResultFromThrown`.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-refusal-details.test.ts`: the pin, on the MCP HTTP face over the real Streamable HTTP transport, the way `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` drives it.
- `.changeset/23529-mcp-action-tools-withhold-permission-details.md`: `@objectstack/mcp` patch.

## Why

The security gate's `PERMISSION_DENIED` carries the caller's own positions and permission-set names in `details`. The ruling on #7450 keeps those off the wire. The dispatcher drops them, the REST actions door answers through `resolveThrownHttpError`'s closed `details` list, and since #23509 the data tools render through `errorResultWithCode`, which never reads `details`. The two action tools rendered through `errorResultFromThrown`, which spread `details` verbatim into a tool result. That tool result rides a JSON-RPC 200, so the dispatcher's withholding never saw it.

Reach, read from source (reading 6176605181, re-read on this tree): `executeDeclarativeUpdateAction` writes through `callData('update', …, ec)` as the caller, and nothing between the security middleware and `errorResultFromThrown` catches the gate's write-side refusal. The subject load does not carry it: `loadActionSubjectRecord`'s bare catch drops the throw and `refuseDeniedSubjectLoad` answers `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` with no `details`.

## Route: the first choice measured, then the second

- **First choice, measured and not taken.** `resolveThrownHttpError` (`@objectstack/types`) builds `details` from a closed list (non-string `code`, `issues`, validation `fields`) and never reads the thrown `details`. A probe on its built output:

  ```text
  ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED -> code ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED status 428 details undefined
  PERMISSION_DENIED -> code PERMISSION_DENIED status 403 details undefined
  ```

  It withholds the denial, but it also drops the confirmation refusal's retry `details`, which `mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts` and `mcp-resume-run-tool.test.ts` pin. So it would break #15942.
- **Taken: the withholding keyed on the declared code, through an existing export.** No key-name list. No second filter of `details`: the class's answer is `errorResultWithCode`'s, reused. Every `PermissionDeniedError` declares this code, because it is a class constant. Every throw in `plugin-security` that puts positions or permission sets in `details` is that class. A throw with no code never reaches the `details` read.
- No other package is edited: `packages/runtime`, `packages/types` and `plugin-security` are untouched, and so is `packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts` (#23367 has it in flight).

## The pin: red on `main`, green after

The bridge is a double, because `@objectstack/mcp` does not depend on `@objectstack/runtime`. It lets the caller read the subject row, and it refuses both action tools with the gate's `PermissionDeniedError` shape. The assertions: the tool error carries `code` `PERMISSION_DENIED` and status 403. Then each position and permission-set name is checked against the whole HTTP response body, not one key. A control row on each tool keeps `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`'s `details` served.

Run against `main`'s renderer (base `e1cefa58e3`, the pin added, no fix):

```text
 ❯ src/mcp-action-refusal-details.test.ts (5 tests | 2 failed)
     × run_action: PERMISSION_DENIED answers code, message and status, and the caller's grants appear nowhere
     × resume_run: PERMISSION_DENIED answers code, message and status, and the caller's grants appear nowhere
+     "details": {
+       "object": "crm_case",
+       "operation": "update",
+       "permissionSets": [ "pin23529_set_case_read_only", "pin23529_set_member_default" ],
+       "positions": [ "pin23529_position_case_reader", "pin23529_position_everyone" ],
      Tests  2 failed | 3 passed (5)
```

After the fix, the pin and the three suites that must not move, unchanged:

```text
src/mcp-action-refusal-details.test.ts src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts src/mcp-resume-run-tool.test.ts
 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  62 passed (62)
```

`mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts` and `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` (its `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` rows included) are byte-unchanged by this PR.

**`resume_run` is covered by a pin, at the renderer.** It calls the same `errorResultFromThrown`, and its row fails and passes with `run_action`'s. By reading, nothing reaches it today: it makes no caller-scope write of its own, and its subject re-read ends at `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. So its row guards the shared renderer, not a measured producer.

## Ablation

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, under the verify lock. The mutation deletes the guard line and the pin runs on the mutated file. The subject resolves through the package's own `src/`, so no build or `dist/` leg applies.

```text
ablation-replace: anchor   x1 -> x0
ablation-replace: blob     232f1b56c0153258f111235257d1597134b53e58 -> c6feca3cd8d737389cf84d21191c717c7c5e149a
     × run_action: PERMISSION_DENIED answers code, message and status, and the caller's grants appear nowhere
     × resume_run: PERMISSION_DENIED answers code, message and status, and the caller's grants appear nowhere
      Tests  2 failed | 3 passed (5)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (232f1b56c015) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The direction is the ordinary one: the two denial rows turn red and the two confirmation controls stay green. That shows the guard is keyed on the code and is not a blanket withhold. `git status` was clean after the restore. `232f1b56c0` is still this file's blob at the head.

## Tests and gates, at head `03c6a098a3`

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: `Test Files 39 passed (39)`, `Tests 467 passed (467)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: exit 0, and `check:test-typecheck: OK` with no new debt. The new test file compiles under `tsconfig.test.json`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp build`: exit 0. The CJS and ESM builds both load. The CJS bundle requires `@objectstack/spec/api`, and it resolves.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 commands. All 63 were run, with each exit code captured before any pipe. Reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 63 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
  - Two gates first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3): `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. I built their prerequisites (`turbo run build`, all but one task a cache hit) and re-ran them. Both exit 0, and those are the readings recorded.
- `main` was merged once before this PR opened. The one incoming commit touched `packages/lint` only, and `@objectstack/lint` was rebuilt.
- CI owns the repo-wide scans and the families that run over a whole root. Their check-runs on this PR are the evidence for them.

## Acceptance notes

- **Residual, noted and not filed (no carrier).** The withholding is keyed on one code. Any other coded refusal's `details` still render verbatim on these two tools. REST passes a thrown refusal's `details` only through the closed list. No other producer that reaches these tools puts caller authorization data in `details` today. A fail-closed alternative is to serve only the confirmation refusal's `details`. It was not taken because it would also drop `resume_run`'s REST-built run artefacts on a failed resume, which narrows more than this card asks.
- **Script-handler rethrow (the reading's second note).** By reading, `executeRegisteredAction` rethrows a handler's own error raw. A rethrown `PermissionDeniedError` keeps its code, so this renderer-level fix covers it with no producer change. No in-tree producer was found.
- **The comment above `errorResultWithCode` is untouched.** It sits outside the claimed surface, and it still holds for that function. `errorResultFromThrown`'s own doc names the one code-keyed exception and why it is not a second copy of the policy.
- **What this pin does not measure.** It does not cover the runtime layers between the gate and the bridge. Those rest on the reading and on #23509's measured fixture, where the gate's `details` reach the MCP HTTP face intact for a data verb.
- **The stdio face** serves no action tools today (the reading's R3). The fix sits in the transport-agnostic renderer, so a host that bridged an action seam onto stdio would get it too.
